visuals.heading: Why a Named List

items.text: Most "AI-proof careers" content stays abstract: judgment, creativity, empathy.
This article works the other way round.
India's ageing population is growing faster than its trained caregiver base.
These roles combine physical assessment with a level of trust a patient or family will not extend to a screen.
Every trade below involves diagnosing a physical problem inside a space that is never quite standard.
Wiring faults, panel upgrades, and safety checks depend on reading a specific building that was never wired to a standard template.

blocks.heading: Licensed Accountability and Live Human-Trust Roles

items.text: This group is the widest because it covers two related but distinct reasons a job resists automation: someone has to be legally answerable for the outcome, or someone has to be physically present and trusted in the moment.
A lawyer has to appear before a judge, cross-examine a witness, and be personally accountable to a bar council for what they argue.
